## Problem and change

Describe the concrete failure or missing behavior and what changes for the user.

## Evidence and validation

- Source revision and relevant experiment/journal reference:
- Offline host checks:

Keep credentials, personal data and private firmware/root images out of the diff
and logs. Preserve failed/inconclusive experiment history. Do not describe a
